sources.seeding_rule: A West team is near Phoenix when it is within 4 games of the Suns in the standings, ahead or behind. The Suns gain when a near team loses. When a near team plays an East team, or a West team outside that range, the page roots against the near team. When two near teams play each other, it roots for the one further from Phoenix, so the closer team takes the loss. If they are equally far, it roots for the team higher in the standings. Head-to-head tiebreakers with the Suns are left out. A game with no near West team has no seeding stake.
sources.pick_rule: Phoenix gets the least favorable of the picks that would convey: Cleveland's, Minnesota's, and Utah's only when Utah sits outside the top 5 of the draft order by record, because Utah's pick is top-5 protected. Every Cleveland and Minnesota game carries the 2027 pick tag, because their records decide which pick Phoenix gets and where it falls. A Utah game carries the tag when Utah's pick is the one Phoenix would get, or when the result would change which pick Phoenix gets. When two of the three teams play each other, the tag follows the one whose pick conveys with the better record. When seeding and the pick point to different teams, seeding wins if the West team involved is within 2 games of Phoenix. Otherwise the pick wins.
sources.marks_rule: Helped means the team the page rooted for won. Hurt means it lost. Every game, tonight's and last night's, is judged on the standings as they stood before it tipped.
sources.order_rule: The draft order lists all 30 teams by win rate from the same balldontlie standings pull, worst record first. Teams with the same win rate share a place and are listed in alphabetical order. The list shows records only. It does not run the lottery, apply playoff results or show lottery odds.
